arms.predicted: A MaxRects packer with multiple placement heuristics (BSSF, BAF, BL, BLSF), diverse item orderings, permutation exhaustion for M<=8, and hill-climbing local search will achieve a score consistently above 90.
arms.observed: Score: 94.84 (averaged over 15 hidden test cases). The solution uses MaxRects with 4 heuristics, 9 sorting strategies, global greedy packing (5 modes), permutation exhaustion for M<=8, hill-climbing with swap+insert neighborhoods on all 4 heuristics, and random perturbation restarts.

discrepancy_analysis: The prediction of score > 90 was confirmed at 94.84. The hill-climbing local search over item orderings added ~0.4 points over pure permutation exhaustion + random shuffle (94.45 -> 94.84). The key finding is that item ordering is the dominant lever, and local search over orderings is more effective than exhaustive permutation for larger M.
